description: This file defines the ConnectException class in the GuzzleHttp library, representing an exception thrown when a network connection cannot be established. It extends TransferException and implements NetworkExceptionInterface, encapsulating details about the failed request and handler context.

classes.name: ConnectException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a network connection cannot be established, contains the original request and handler context for debugging.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the original request object that caused the exception.

methods.name: getHandlerContext
methods.description: Returns the contextual information about the error from the underlying handler.
